cover_letter_text:
Hi Cardinia Shire Council team,

I'm Marc, and I'm after a graduate engineering role. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and in February 2026 I graduated with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. Your new Development Engineer role is open to recent graduates and values an understanding of drainage principles, so I'm applying.

In the course I designed stormwater drainage, roads and earthworks in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. On site in the Philippines, from April 2019 to February 2020, I reviewed drawings, did quality checks and wrote the site and progress reports.

I'm based in Melton with my own car and a full Victorian driver's licence. I can start three weeks after an offer and have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate

questions.question: Do you hold a current Victorian Drivers license

Do you have the right to work in Australia? If you are on a visa, please specify the type of visa you hold. Additionally, please indicate if you are a Permanent Resident, Australian Citizen, or New Zealand Citizen.
questions.answer: Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate visa with full working rights until December 2027.

questions.question: When will you be available for this role?
We operate in a hybrid model. If you are in an office-based role, do you have a home workstation set up to ensure a safe working environment?
questions.answer: Yes, I have a home workstation set up with my own laptop (Acer Nitro 5).

questions.question: Our positions require a pre-employment medical and Police Records Check. Additionally, some roles may necessitate a Financial Background Check, Traffic Check, or Working with Children Check.If you are the preferred candidate, do you accept this as a condition of offer of employment?
